## 5 Choice Analysis

```{r process raw data file}

# choose file for the analysis
file <- file.choose()

# read results sheet from the file
results <- read_excel(file, sheet = "Results", col_names = FALSE)

# find out how many rows to skip
idx_corr <- which(results$...1 == "Nb_correct_responses")
idx_incorr <- which(results$...1 == "Nb_incorrect_responses")
idx_omi <- which(results$...1 == "Nb_omissions")
idx_prem <- which(results$...1 == "Nb_premature_responses")
idx_error <- which(results$...1 == "Nb_error")
  
idx_delcorr <- which(results$...1 == "Delay_correct_responses")

# extract different response type data
corr <- results[(idx_corr + 1):(idx_incorr - 3),]
incorr <- results[(idx_incorr + 1):(idx_omi - 3),]
omi <- results[(idx_omi + 1):(idx_prem - 3),]
prem <- results[(idx_prem + 1):(idx_error - 3),]
error <- results[(idx_error + 1):(idx_delcorr - 3),]

# create empty data frame to store final data  
data <- tibble()
  
# create empty vector to store sessions, animal ids and correct responses
sessions <- c()
animal_id <- c()
correct <- c()
  
# loop over the above extracted correct response data to extract animal ids, 
# -session numbers, and response values

# approach:   # read columns to get individual animal data
              # then check each animal entry until empty cell is found (NA)
              # make a note of the index of the empty cell
              # get session no. and correct value from the last filled cell (empty - 1) 

for (id in 2:nrow(corr)) {
  
  # extract training number from the file name
  #tr_nr <- as.character(str_split(corr[id,1], "_|.sea")[[1]][[3]])

  # get animal id
  animal <- str_split(corr[id,1], "_|.sea")[[1]][[4]]
  # save animal id in the animal_id vector
  animal_id <- c(animal_id, animal)
  
  # get animal data
  animal_data <- corr[id,2:(ncol(corr))]
  # get index of NAs
  idx_emt <- which(is.na(animal_data))
  # get last session number
  sea_tot <- idx_emt[1] - 1
  # save session number in the sessions vector
  sessions <- c(sessions, sea_tot)
    
  # get correct response value 
  res <- animal_data[sea_tot][[1]]
  # save correct response value in the correct vector
  correct <- c(correct, res)
}

# convert correct and animal_id vector from character to numeric
correct <- as.numeric(correct)
animal_id <- as.numeric(animal_id)
# create a data frame containing correct responses, animal ids, and session numbers 
data_c <- tibble(animal_id, correct, sessions)
  
#-------------------
 
# create empty vector to store animal ids and incorrect responses 
animal_id <- c()
incorrect <- c()
  
# loop over the previously extracted incorrect response data to extract animal ids, 
# -session numbers, and response values
for (id in 2:nrow(incorr)) {
  # get animal id
  animal <- str_split(incorr[id,1], "_|.sea")[[1]][[4]]
  # save animal id in the animal_id vector
  animal_id <- c(animal_id, animal)

  # get animal data
  animal_data <- incorr[id,2:(ncol(incorr))]
  # get index of NAs
  idx_emt <- which(is.na(animal_data))
  # get last session number
  sea_tot <- idx_emt[1] - 1

  #sessions <- c(sessions, sea_tot)

  # get incorrect response value 
  res <- animal_data[sea_tot][[1]]
  # save incorrect response value in the incorrect vector
  incorrect <- c(incorrect, res)
}

# convert incorrect and animal_id vector from character to numeric  
incorrect <- as.numeric(incorrect)
animal_id <- as.numeric(animal_id)
# create a data frame containing incorrect responses, and animal ids
data_inc <- tibble(animal_id, incorrect)

# join correct and incorrect data frame to create the final data frame (data)  
data <- full_join(data_c, data_inc, by = "animal_id")
  
#-------------------

# create empty vector to store animal ids and omissions responses   
animal_id <- c()
omissions <- c()

# loop over the previously extracted omissions response data to extract animal ids, 
# -session numbers, and response values  
for (id in 2:nrow(omi)) {
  # get animal id
  animal <- str_split(omi[id,1], "_|.sea")[[1]][[4]]
  # save animal id in the animal_id vector
  animal_id <- c(animal_id, animal)

  # get animal data
  animal_data <- omi[id,2:(ncol(omi))]
  # get index of NAs
  idx_emt <- which(is.na(animal_data))
  # get last session number
  sea_tot <- idx_emt[1] - 1

  #sessions <- c(sessions, sea_tot)

  # get omissions response value
  res <- animal_data[sea_tot][[1]]
  # save omissions response value in the omissions vector
  omissions <- c(omissions, res)
}

# convert omissions and animal_id vector from character to numeric  
omissions <- as.numeric(omissions)
animal_id <- as.numeric(animal_id)
# create a data frame containing omissions responses, and animal ids
data_omi <- tibble(animal_id, omissions)
  
# join omissions data frame with the final data frame (data)
data <- full_join(data, data_omi, by = "animal_id") 
  
#-------------------

# create empty vector to store animal ids and premature responses    
animal_id <- c()
premature <- c()

# loop over the previously extracted premature response data to extract animal ids, 
# -session numbers, and response values   
for (id in 2:nrow(prem)) {
  # get animal id
  animal <- str_split(prem[id,1], "_|.sea")[[1]][[4]]
  # save animal id in the animal_id vector
  animal_id <- c(animal_id, animal)

  # get animal data
  animal_data <- prem[id,2:(ncol(prem))]
  # get index of NAs
  idx_emt <- which(is.na(animal_data))
  # get last session number
  sea_tot <- idx_emt[1] - 1

  #  sessions <- c(sessions, sea_tot)

  # get premature response value
  res <- animal_data[sea_tot][[1]]
  # save premature response value in the premature vector
  premature <- c(premature, res)
}
 
# convert premature and animal_id vector from character to numeric 
premature <- as.numeric(premature)
animal_id <- as.numeric(animal_id)
# create a data frame containing premature responses, and animal ids
data_prem <- tibble(animal_id, premature)
 
# join premature data frame with the final data frame (data) 
data <- full_join(data, data_prem, by = "animal_id") 
 
# calculate total_trials, percentage of correct, incorrect, omissions and 
# -premature responses and store them in new columns
data <- data %>%
  mutate(total_trials = (correct + incorrect + omissions + premature),
         percent_corr = (correct/total_trials),
         percent_incorr = (incorrect/total_trials),
         percent_omi = (omissions/total_trials),
         percent_prem = (premature/total_trials),
         animal_id = as.character(animal_id)
  )

# reorder columns in final data frame (data)  
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(animal_id, correct, incorrect, omissions, premature, total_trials, percent_corr, percent_incorr, percent_omi, percent_prem, sessions)
  
#  data %>%
#    group_by(names(data)) %>%
#    summarize(Average = mean(names(data)))

# create a vector containing average values of different columns  
average <- c("Average", mean(data$correct), mean(data$incorrect), mean(data$omissions), mean(data$premature), mean(data$total_trials), mean(data$percent_corr), mean(data$percent_incorr), mean(data$percent_omi), mean(data$percent_prem))
 
# bind the above created vector to the final data frame (data)     
data <- rbind(data, average)   
  
# save the final data frame (data)  
write.csv(data, paste("Excel_",Sys.Date(),".csv", sep = ""),row.names = FALSE)
      
```
